ValidationRule.description: A seasonal day is a day its month has: 1 to 31, 1 to 30 in April, June, September and November, 1 to 29 in February.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Seasonal_Start_Day__c)), OR(Seasonal_Start_Day__c < 1, Seasonal_Start_Day__c > IF(ISBLANK(Seasonal_Start_Month__c), 31, CASE(Seasonal_Start_Month__c, 2, 29, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31)))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Seasonal_End_Day__c)), OR(Seasonal_End_Day__c < 1, Seasonal_End_Day__c > IF(ISBLANK(Seasonal_End_Month__c), 31, CASE(Seasonal_End_Month__c, 2, 29, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31)))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A seasonal day is a day its month has: 1 to 31, or 1 to 30 in April, June, September and November, or 1 to 29 in February.
